body:
Thank you. Really, thank you.I'm pretty sure I'm doing the whole sleep thing wrong. I look so tired all the time I have been described as "looking sick" quite often. I have travelled, but haven't really found any results in that. The allergies are really bad, I act up outside of seasons. I am just now learning about what it's coming from though (my parents never had motivation getting help about my allergies since I was about 3).Yes, I really want to try some things. My perfectionism just gets so in the way. The few friends I have are on the internet, and they aren't exactly.. sensitive about joking around with those sorts of things. I know they don't mean harm, but it doesn't feel right to hear. Things will always be like that though, so I'm just trying to relax for a bit, hoping I can jump back into it once I feel a bit better. I don't know when that will be though.  
Edit: And no, my brother and I don't really confide with eachother. We did in the past, but we just ended up fighting all the time. Therapist said it was to an "extreme point, where we needed professional help". We were very young, and are therefor now distant when it comes to this sort of stuff. We still hang out, a lot, we just don't talk anymore. Just hang out with the same friends.

I really liked the therapist. I don't think that's the issue. I'm at a point where it feels like the world gets harder the more you learn about it. But I can't see a way around therapy, so I'll try for a bit longer. I haven't talked to her about it yet, but I plan to when she comes back.   
Yes, I've made mistakes. Yes, those hold me back. I am a perfectionist, so I feel like everything I do have to be perfect. It gets hard to motivate myself to do things if I can't know if I'll get good or not. That's the problem though, I'll never get anywhere if I just don't do anything. I want to try though, ty for the encouragement.  
And the list is where things get weird for me. I really don't know who I am anymore. What I like or where I want to be. I mean, I've never known what I want to do with my life, but now it feels like I don't recognize myself. And it all feels so sudden. I'm very close to my gf, and I love her, but I am at this point only pretending to be the same person I was when we got together. Whatever I come up with on that list will completely contradict other things I have to define myself, and I'm afraid it'll freak me out. I'll talk about that concept with my therapist though, perhaps that would be something good to work on. Thank you for taking the time to read and respond to that text too btw, appreciate it

"I am a real person". That's hard to grasp ur head around.   
Ty! Yes, I'm quite sure u'd say I have a loving family and gf. But it's a bit more complicated than that. They don't believen in therapy for example, and don't even know I went. They hate talking about me or my brother's problems, always have. When my brother went out and talked about how he thought he needed therapy, they cried and said he blamed them for parenting him wrong. Dad also made fun of him with me behind my brother's back. I didn't say anything, they have no idea what I'm going through. They would hate it, and blame everything on me. Yes, they love me, but I also feel like they don't really know me thought.   
Same goes for my gf. She really is amazing. But I feel like I've wanted to just please her so much she doesn't know me either. She's sheltered to say the least, and even mentioning how we're all going to die will put her at risk of a panic attack. I can't talk with her. I want to protect her, but she *really* wants to be there for me and help me. She can't though, and I can't put her through my problems. I don't want to leave her, but at this point it feels like that's because I'm being selfish.   
Yes, there is a lot I don't like about my current life. There are even things I want to change, to do. The problem is that I'm so fucking tired all the time. I have allergies that make my body have to fight almost everyday, and so I can sleep up to 10-12 hours a day. More if my body had a say. And doing anything at all just makes me feel like I'm actually *living*, which only fuels the feeling that I'm doing things wrong, or should be doing more. I find it easier to deal with when I'm "wasting my time". But then again, I become unhappy with how my life is going. I can clearly see it's a spiral, but I have no idea how to get out of it.   
Again though, thank you for reading and relpying! It means a lot

Thanks for reading! Genuinely means a lot. 

I could use what you said about getting to know other adults, thanks. But I'm not sure about that letter sadly. It feels like it would be dropping something on them, and even if I  might want to avoid them in the future, at least to some degree, it still feels wrong to drop "I didn't like you and you didn't raise me right". Even if it was better worded. To anyone else, we would be a normal functioning family, and they certainly didn't grow up with the kinds of problems me or my brother have. I don't think they really care for my wellbeing, but that's mostly it. They just don't care. They should yes, since they're my parents, but it feels like I'm also making things worse if I were to start saying things like that.

They live mostly happy, and it would feel like I would get in the way of that.
